description: The Saloon is a large timber interior arranged around a long bar and several round tables. Bottles line the shelves above the left-hand counter, with red-topped stools in a neat row below. Lanterns and candles brighten the tables, which carry cards, glasses and small dishes. A stone fireplace burns on the upper right beneath a mounted horned skull, and a piano stands beside it. A wooden stair climbs behind the bar towards the upper landing. The golden plank floor remains open between the clusters of chairs, linking the bar, hearth and the doors out to the town and wider worlds.

landmarks.description: Cards, drinks and a lamp cover the large round table in the middle of the room.
